title: iliamna remota var. typica
intro: Iliamna remota var. typica, commonly known as "prickly poppy" or "prickly thistle", is a plant species within the Malvaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Iliamna remota var. typica include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of this plant include analgesic, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as triterpenoids and flavonoids.
